status_detail: Large data center campus off Rumble Road/I-75; originally proposed by Data Core Innovations in 2024, rezoned from agricultural to industrial by Monroe County in November 2024, later taken over/expanded by Cloverleaf Infrastructure. Reported as 12 buildings and 4.2 million sq ft with buildout into 2038/2039.
notes: Primary county signal is rezoning/DRI coverage; capacity from data-center tracker/news reporting. Project appears separate from Google's later Rumble Road land purchase.

project_name: Google Rumble Road data center land
status_detail: Google purchased about 948-950 acres along Rumble Road near I-75 in September 2025 for a potential/future data center; Google confirmed the acquisition was to preserve an option for growth but gave no development timeline.
notes: GPB/The Telegraph cites county property records and Google spokesperson confirmation. Treat as land-banked/planned option, not construction.

status_detail: Proposed roughly 900-970 acre data center campus near I-475 and Highway 41 South; DRI #4446 was filed, but Monroe County commissioners denied the rezoning request in August 2025 after Planning and Zoning recommended denial.
notes: Official Monroe County PDF identifies DRI #4446 Bolingbroke Technology Campus; third-party tracker reports 900 MW, while some coverage describes 1.2 GW. Kept 900 MW as conservative structured value.

status_detail: City of Forsyth council approved a 1,600+ acre data center campus west of I-75 in February 2026; DRI #4585 final report covers the Forsyth Technology Campus and describes a 12 million sq ft project with major water/power impacts.

project_name: Baymare / Meta Stanton Springs 2 data center
status_detail: Joint Development Authority of Jasper, Morgan, Newton and Walton Counties approved a $42B bond and land sale for Baymare LLC in Stanton Springs; JDA reports say Baymare construction was underway and assigned to Morning Hornet LLC. Newton County official JDA page lists the future home of Baymare's Data Center in the four-county JDA area.
notes: Stanton Springs is a four-county JDA involving Morgan County; the precise county parcel boundary should be verified in assessor/GIS before assigning only to Morgan. Included because Morgan County participates in the JDA and residents/official records discuss data center impacts.
